_doc: Hand-checked card earn rules (KrisFlyer miles per S$). Verified 7 Nov 2026 against bank pages, milelion.com and mainlymiles.com (10 Nov 2026: every card here except OCBC Rewards re-read against the bank's own terms). Keys = card ids. A bucket earns its mpd while its cap has room; the first bucket that matches wins (order = priority). match: mcc (list, ranges 'a-b'), merchant (regex on the merchant text), fcy (true = foreign currency), channel (contactless|mobile|online|any; alerts rarely say, so default_channel = the way of paying that earns the card's bonus). cap = S$ of eligible spend per period (calendar month or statement period). min_spend: bonus only when the bucket's period spend reaches it (shown as provisional until then). rounding: per_txn_5 = floor(S$/5) blocks per transaction, pooled = the period total is rounded once, per_1 = floor to S$1. Promos carry 'until'. no_assume: a merchant with NO known MCC is assumed to earn the bonus of the card it was paid with, except in buckets marked no_assume (SIA, petrol) or matched by merchant name only. assume_fcy: a card kept for foreign charges only, so a line counts as foreign currency unless its text says Singapore.

common._note: utilities, insurance, education, hospitals, charity/religious/political, government/tax, gambling, brokerage, quasi-cash, wire transfers, parking + wallet/bill top-ups. Bank-specific additions below.

buckets.label: Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam: charged in IDR, MYR, THB or VND

uob_prvi_miles_visa.notes: Uncapped, no minimum. Checked against UOB's own documents on 11 Nov 2026: Terms and Conditions Governing UOB PRVI Miles Card (exclusions, Agoda and Expedia perks) and the UOB Rewards+ T&C (earn rates).

buckets.label: Dining / shopping / travel / play / FCY
buckets.min_basis: eligible spend (bonus and non-bonus, supplementary cards included; excluded transactions and Etiqa insurance don't count)

maybank_xl.notes: Minimum S$500 of eligible spend per calendar month (under it the whole month earns 0.4); bonus cap S$1,000 a month. ocbc_titanium.name: OCBC Rewards

buckets.label: Watsons / Shopee / Lazada / Taobao / TikTok Shop (promo)

ocbc_titanium.notes: 4 mpd (50 OCBC$ per S$5) on the shopping MCCs and named merchants; the bonus is capped at 10,000 OCBC$ a calendar month = about S$1,110 of spend, shared with supplementary cards, and OCBC may count other campaigns' bonus (the 6 mpd promo) toward it. Bonus points post by the end of the next month. Points per S$5 block per transaction. Shopee Pay (MCC 5262) earns nothing; MCC 5411 earns no bonus. No points at all while on SmartChange. OCBC$ expire after 24 months. Checked on 10 Nov 2026 against OCBC's Rewards Card Programme T&C (updated 5 Oct 2026). 6 mpd promotion (15X OCBC$ Campaign T&C, 1 Jul 2026): an extra 5 OCBC$ per S$1 at Watsons, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and Taobao, up to 5,000 bonus OCBC$ a calendar month (S$1,000 of spend), 1 Jul 2026 to 31 Mar 2027, by posting date. Exclusions per OCBC's Cards Rewards Transaction Exclusion List (4 Nov 2026); it also names AXS, SAM, EZ-Link, Transit Link and ShopeePay. NOT checked against a bank document: the annual fee and its waiver rule. Fee waiver is asked for in the OCBC app (More > Card Services > Request fee waiver).

Both share one bonus limit of 28,800 points (8,000 miles) a month. Everything else: 0.14 miles per S$ (0.5 point). Above the bonus limit yuu shops earn 0.28 (app counts 0.14). Base points at yuu shops need the yuu ID scanned at payment. No bonus at Changi Airport stores or Cold Storage On The Go; no points on gift cards, tobacco, top-ups. Supplementary card spend counts for the principal. Checked against DBS yuu Card T&C (updated 30 Oct 2026) and the DBS product page on 14 Nov 2026.
